rationale: The attestation in Ps. Spl. 118, 95 (a psalm context) suggests a sense of mentally perceiving or grasping meaning — the classic sense of intellectually apprehending something — which aligns best with understand.v.02 ("perceive an idea or situation mentally"). This is a more cognitively immediate sense than understand.v.01 (which implies ongoing comprehension of a person/thing) and fits the psalmic register where the speaker perceives divine understanding/insight.
